svg.text: Work lists (#4330): empty, loading, error, paging
Each tile is the list's content under the filter bar, on the Mac (the Remote and the web are the same, in their own row). parts.md §7.
1. Loading, first read
Placeholder rows that shimmer (.redacted). No spinner.
Web: a CSS skeleton.

g.text: Work look: wireframe the Issues and Pu…
Sidebar: Work as a folding group
Machine lock: recovery key after the c…
Forge: one interface for every forge

svg.text: 2. Loading, a refresh
The rows stay; Refresh spins (top right). iPhone: the pull-to-refresh
spinner. A row that changed updates in place.
3. Empty, no filter
The page's glyph. Pull requests: 'No open pull requests'.
State Closed: 'No closed issues'. Several repos: 'on 3 repos'.
4. Empty, with a filter
Says the filters that are set, and Clear filters (all but
State and Sort). Text in the search field counts as a filter.

g.text: Connect a forge to see issues

svg.text: 5. No forge connected
Today's words (noForgeHere) in the new layout. A machine
too old to read issues: 'Update Agents on <machine>'.

g.text: Work look: wireframe the Issues and Pu…
Sidebar: Work as a folding group
Machine lock: recovery key after the c…

svg.text: 6. Error, with rows from the last read
A strip above the list, one line per machine that failed
(the machine's name only with 2+). The rows stay, dimmed.
7. Error, no rows
The strip goes to the middle. A credential error adds
'Settings ▸ Connectors' as a second button.

g.text: Machine lock: recovery key after the c…
Forge: one interface for every forge
Competitor: a board view of every agen…

svg.text: 8. Loading more
When the last row shows, the next page loads; a spinner row
at the end. The web: the footer is a Load more button too.
9. End of the list, or a page that failed
At the end: the count in grey ('128 issues', or '50+ issues'
when the forge gives no total). A failed page: one line, Try again.
